name: reliant-monorepo
description: Reliant AI coding assistant with Electron desktop app
author: Reliant Labs <hello@reliantlabs.io>

scripts.build:backend: go build -buildvcs=false -o dist/reliant.tmp ./cmd/reliant && mv dist/reliant.tmp dist/reliant
scripts.build:backend:v2: go build -buildvcs=false -o dist/reliant.tmp ./cmd/reliant && mv dist/reliant.tmp dist/reliant
scripts.build:backend:clean: rm -f dist/reliant && go build -buildvcs=false -o dist/reliant.tmp ./cmd/reliant && mv dist/reliant.tmp dist/reliant
scripts.build:backend:clean:v2: rm -f dist/reliant && go build -buildvcs=false -o dist/reliant.tmp ./cmd/reliant && mv dist/reliant.tmp dist/reliant
scripts.postinstall: cd web && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../electron && npm install

//overrides note: Transitive-only pin. uuid: GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when `buf` is provided), reached only through xcode -> @expo/config-plugins, which pins uuid ^7. xcode calls uuid.v4() exclusively and never passes `buf`, so the vulnerable path is unreachable here; the override is to keep `npm audit` clean rather than to close real exposure. uuid 11 keeps the named v4 export xcode uses. Remove once xcode's own range reaches >=11.1.1.
